findings.finding: The motion-feasibility distractor assigns a downstream geometric task to ASR, while another swaps transcription and synthesis wholesale. Use plausible transcript-versus-intent failure diagnoses rather than unrelated module roles.

Remembering a predicate is used to imply newly sampled neural tokens in o4. This is a category error, not a plausible distinction between pattern/template retrieval and dense-vector retrieval. Keep alternatives focused on actual retrieval mechanisms and state.
The claim that any stored variable requires trained neural weights is a conspicuous category error. Replace it with a realistic confusion about programmed state, wildcard coverage or rule updates.

The distractors make scripted responses incompatible with any memory or elevate saved text to a complete learned world model. Use plausible alternatives about what MEMORY stores, when it is reused and its bounded scope.

Only the correct alternative acknowledges the stipulated toy policy and historical caveat; o4 invents runtime learning. Make all alternatives parallel priority traces, and state the historical scope in the common premise.

Equal word count and identical characters are implausible explanations of stipulated nearby semantic vectors; the new-LLM sentence option changes the response mechanism. Use genuine similarity-versus-exact-match or ranking misconceptions.

Two options invent automatic authorship or novel factual generation despite the explicit retrieval-only fixed-bank premise. Keep alternatives about relative score, adequacy, threshold or fallback behavior.

The source-scoped key is correct, but the teaching explanation silently reinforces the slide’s Linguist spelling. Add an explicit qualification that Wallace/Pandorabots expands ALICE as Artificial Linguistic Internet Computer Entity. Preserve the printed-versus-standard distinction; do not silently change the source-scoped key.

All distractors impose mandatory dense vectors, online neural updates or unrestricted synthesis on two explicitly authored-pattern systems. Compare plausible shared versus differing pattern, script and state features instead.
A hidden assignment certifying motion feasibility is an unrelated category error. Use plausible distinctions among template approval, substituted text, contextual scope and downstream validation.

AutoTokenizer as a web form and AutoModelForCausalLM as response display make two alternatives easy to dismiss without tracing the code. Use parallel permutations of tokenizer, model and inference-wrapper roles. The explanation should describe intended roles rather than imply the literal invalid module ran.

Sample-rate ordering and vocabulary size are causally remote from interruption handling. Compare plausible concurrent-processing, buffering and response-control evidence instead.
Capitalization and response-template identifiers are weak nonacoustic substitutes for how speech was delivered. Use plausible vocal/linguistic cue distinctions.

Stored history turning inference into direct mind reading is a conspicuous straw alternative. Keep distractors about uncertainty, calibration, observations and inference rather than impossible direct access.

Cue disagreement proving deliberate deception and emotion always depending on one acoustic feature are implausible absolutes. Use competing multimodal fusion or clarification policies under the common fallibility premise.
